title: An ambient ductile TiHfVNbTa refractory high-entropy alloy: Cold rolling, mechanical properties, lattice distortion, and first-principles prediction
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting with high purity (>99.95%) metal elements in a Ti-gettered argon atmosphere. Ingots were melted multiple times with flipping. Rolled into a sheet with 84% thickness reduction. Dog-bone specimens annealed at 1200°C for 45 min in 5×10^-3 torr vacuum.
